description: Store an instruction or convention to remember across sessions. Provide 'key' (short snake_case) and 'value' (the full text). scope: 'repo' (default, this repository), 'user' (all your repositories), or 'team' (this repository, and shared as a team candidate that teammates' agents receive once a person promotes it). Values containing credentials are refused.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root.

key.description: A short snake_case identifier for this memory, e.g. 'api_response_format', 'naming_convention', 'testing_strategy'. This is used to retrieve the memory later.

scope.description: Where the memory applies. Default: repo.

value.description: The full instruction or convention text to persist. This is the content that will be recalled in future sessions.

name: rigour_remember
